name: Asana
description: Asana work management: browse workspaces, projects, sections and tasks, read task comments, search tasks, and create, update or comment on tasks through the REST API.
instructions:
Asana organises work as workspaces, projects, sections and tasks. This adapter reads them and can create tasks, update them and post comments as the token's user.

**Getting credentials**
1. In Asana, click your profile photo, then Settings, Apps, View developer console (older menus say Manage developer apps), or open https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps.
2. Under Personal access tokens choose Create new token, give it a name, accept the terms and copy the token into `ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN`. It is shown only once and acts with your permissions.

**Workflow**: start with `asana_get_me` (it also lists your workspaces) or `asana_list_workspaces`. Pass a workspace gid to `asana_list_projects`, then a project gid to `asana_list_tasks` or `asana_list_sections`. For your own work, call `asana_list_tasks` with `assignee` = `me` plus `workspace`. `asana_get_task` returns notes, custom fields and memberships; `asana_list_task_stories` returns comments and activity.

**Formats and gotchas**: every id is a string gid, e.g. `1204567890123456`. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, times ISO 8601 UTC. Each read tool sends `opt_fields` with a compact default field list; pass your own comma-separated list (nested fields with dots, e.g. `assignee.name`) to get other fields. `completed_since=now` returns only incomplete tasks. `asana_search_tasks` needs a premium workspace or team; other users get HTTP 402, so fall back to `asana_list_tasks`. Search results lag writes by up to a minute.

**Writes**: `asana_create_task`, `asana_update_task` and `asana_add_comment` change real data visible to the team. Show the user what will be written and wait for confirmation; never retry a successful create.

**Pagination and rate limits**: list tools send `limit` (default 50, max 100). While more results exist the body holds `next_page.offset`: call again with `offset` set to it until `next_page` is null. Search has no `next_page`: sort by `created_at` and narrow with `created_after`. Asana allows 150 requests per minute on free domains, 1500 on paid ones, and 60 per minute for search; on HTTP 429 wait for the `Retry-After` seconds.

**Cloud reachability**: `app.asana.com` is a public HTTPS API, so AnythingMCP Cloud and self-hosted installs reach it without extra network setup.

ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Personal access token
ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Create it in the Asana developer console under Personal access tokens, then Create new token. Paste only the token.
ASANA_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces or the word Bearer.

verifyHints.401: Asana refused the token. Personal access tokens are shown once; create a new one in the developer console (https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps) and paste it without the word Bearer.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Asana allows 150 requests per minute on free domains and 1500 on paid ones. Wait for the Retry-After time and try again.

tools.name: asana_get_me
tools.description: Get the Asana user behind the access token: gid, name, email and the workspaces it belongs to. Call this first to confirm the connection and pick a workspace gid.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Default: name,email,workspaces.name.

tools.name: asana_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Asana workspaces and organizations visible to the token's user, with their gids. Most other tools need a workspace gid from here.

offset.description: Page token: next_page.offset from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Default: name,is_organization.

tools.name: asana_list_projects
tools.description: List projects in one Asana workspace, optionally only archived or only active ones. Returns project gids for asana_list_tasks and asana_list_sections. Page with offset = next_page.offset until next_page is null.

workspace.description: Workspace gid from asana_list_workspaces or asana_get_me.

archived.description: true for archived projects only, false for active projects only. Omit for both.

offset.description: Page token: next_page.offset from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: asana_get_project
tools.description: Get one Asana project by gid: description, owner, team, members, dates, latest status update and custom field settings.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. The default covers description, owner, team, members, dates, status update title and custom field names.

tools.name: asana_list_tasks
tools.description: List Asana tasks of one project, one section, or one assignee in a workspace. Give project, or section, or assignee together with workspace. Use completed_since=now for open tasks only. Page with offset = next_page.offset until next_page is null.

project.description: Project gid. Lists the project's tasks.

section.description: Section gid from asana_list_sections. Lists the tasks in that section.

assignee.description: User gid, email or me. Requires workspace.

workspace.description: Workspace gid. Only valid together with assignee.

completed_since.description: Only tasks that are incomplete or were completed after this ISO 8601 time; now returns open tasks only.

modified_since.description: Only tasks modified after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

offset.description: Page token: next_page.offset from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: asana_get_task
tools.description: Get one Asana task by gid with its description, assignee, dates, projects and sections, parent, tags, custom field values, followers and subtask count.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. The default covers the task's description, people, dates, placement, tags and custom field values.

tools.name: asana_search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks across an Asana workspace by text, assignee, project, due date, completion and modification time. Premium only: non-premium users get HTTP 402, then use asana_list_tasks. There is no next_page; sort by created_at and narrow with created_after to see more.

text.description: Full-text match on task name and description.

assignee_any.description: Comma-separated user gids, emails or me.

completed.description: true for completed tasks only, false for incomplete tasks only.

created_after.description: Created after this ISO 8601 time; use with sort_by=created_at to page through results.

is_subtask.description: true for subtasks only, false to exclude subtasks.

sort_by.description: Sort order; Asana's default is modified_at.

sort_ascending.description: true for ascending order. Default false.

tools.name: asana_list_sections
tools.description: List the sections (list headers or board columns) of an Asana project with their gids, for filtering asana_list_tasks by section.

offset.description: Page token: next_page.offset from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Default: name,created_at.

tools.name: asana_list_task_stories
tools.description: List the comments and activity (stories) of an Asana task. Set resource_subtype=comment_added to skip assignment and date-change activity, and sort_ascending=false with a small limit to read only the latest ones.

resource_subtype.description: comment_added returns comments only. Omit for the full activity feed.

sort_ascending.description: true (Asana default) is oldest first, false is newest first.

offset.description: Page token: next_page.offset from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: asana_create_task
tools.description: Create a new Asana task. Writes real data visible to the team: show the user the name, project, assignee and due date and get confirmation first. Give projects or workspace. Each call creates another task, so never retry a successful call.

projects.description: Project gids to add the task to, e.g. ["1204567890123456"].

workspace.description: Workspace gid; needed only when no projects or parent are given.

parent.description: Parent task gid to create a subtask.

due_on.description: Due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Do not combine with due_at.

due_at.description: Due time, ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-10-20T15:00:00Z. Do not combine with due_on.

start_on.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD; needs due_on or due_at.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return for the new task.

tools.name: asana_update_task
tools.description: Update an Asana task: rename it, change its description, mark it complete or incomplete, reassign it or move its dates. Only the fields you pass change. Changes real data: confirm the change with the user first.

notes.description: New plain-text description; replaces the existing one.

completed.description: true to mark complete, false to reopen.

assignee.description: New assignee: user gid, email or me.

due_on.description: New due date, YYYY-MM-DD. Do not combine with due_at.

due_at.description: New due time, ISO 8601 UTC. Do not combine with due_on.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return for the updated task.

tools.name: asana_add_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on an Asana task as the token's user. Followers are notified, so show the user the exact text and get confirmation first. Each call posts another comment.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return for the new comment.
